Asain grocery stores. If you have any near you, skip Walmart, go straight to the Asain grocery store. It depends on where you are, but in general, vegetables are much cheaper (I'm talking getting a cucumber for 69 cents at a chain store, or 49 cents, and most Asain stores have everything you could buy at a chain store anyway, vegetable-wise) there are prepared microwave meals just like anywhere else (I haven't had any luck with finding frozen pizzas yet, but that's probably a good thing for my health,) and boxed dinners, although mostly Asain themed and ramen (get the ramen noodles that aren't the pre-prepared ones instead, and try some of the sauces and mixes they have- my advice? Look for the grumpiest old granny on the package, and you'll know it's a good sauce, trust me, it works) are much cheaper than what you'd find at a chain store. They also usually have eggs, (my store I like to go to has a whole whopping $1 for a dozen medium eggs) milk, bread, and anything else you need. (Maybe not pasta, though. For that you'll have to wait on coupons and sales, I guess, because if you're paying more than a dollar a box for pasta, I aughtta smack you silly, there's no reason for that.)

Oh, and you know Pocky? Those delicious snack sticks dipped in chocolate, or pink substance that's strawberry flavored? Yeah, those are 50 cents at my store. I'm willing to bet they are at a store near you, too. (And the Hello Panda snacks that have cute panda printed on them and are filled with chocolate, or that same strawberry stuff, and a few other flavors, too. I love those.) Also, at my store, tofu is 95 cents. I go to Walmart and it's $2.50 on sale. Most Asain grocery stores sell it for around a dollar. Consider that the next time you don't want to pay a ton of money for meat, but you're feeling a little protein deficient. A block of tofu can last several days and add some protein to your dish. You just soak your desired amount over night in what ever flavoring or sauce you'd like, and it tastes like that instead of tofu, which I understand not everyone is a fan of.

So that's my mega secret. I've told no one for years. People just think I have a bad case of culture worship because I try to shop at the Asian grocery as much as possible. Ha ha. But check it out. They're seriously cheap!
